description: Create column Type in title at index 9 based on column Title using expression grel:if(value.toLowercase().contains(cells["Type"].value), "yes", "no")

expression: grel:with(cells["Type"].value, ty, if(isNull(value.toLowercase().match("(?s).*\\b(" + ty + "|" + ty.replace(/y$/, "") + ")(s|es|y|ies)?\\b.*")), "part of other word", "whole word"))
